pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.6: Guided reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Guided reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What do you do to get information from a text when reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify language features in given texts
2. read texts correctly using acquired phonemes

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify language features in given texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify language features in given texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. read texts correctly using acquired phonemes
   In simple words: practise until you can read texts correctly using acquired phonemes. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Guided reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Guided reading in the examples.
2. Explain Guided reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Guided reading.
4. Show that you can: identify language features in given texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Guided reading important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read along to numbers being counted,
2. Compare how numbers 20-100 are read in their various languages,
3. Discuss the differences in counting numbers above 20 in various languages,
4. Read short texts on people talking about their family members (z.B. Das ist mein Vater/meine Mutter. Er/sie ist fünfzig Jahre alt),

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify language features in given texts
2. read texts correctly using acquired phonemes

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
